title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Carrying out the Activity of Learning from Comrade Chen Jiaxiang
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Carrying Out Activities to Learn from Comrade Chen Jiaqi

Fa (Ren) Fa [1988] No. 9

To all local people's courts at various levels, all military courts at various levels, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, and all maritime courts:

Comrade Chen Jiaqi, President of the People's Court of Lishu County, Jilin Province, has been diligent and devoted to his duties consistently, and has been commended and awarded on multiple occasions.

Since the Third Plenary Session of the Eleventh Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Comrade Chen Jiaqi has adhered to the Four Cardinal Principles and firmly implemented the Party's reform and opening-up policy. Based on his own duties and keeping the overall situation in mind, he actively carried out trial work to serve socialist economic construction, reform, and opening-up. He upheld truth, showed no favoritism, maintained integrity, and enforced the law resolutely. He kept in mind the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly, was strict with himself, set an example through his own conduct, and cultivated a positive court culture through practical actions, achieving outstanding results in all tasks. His exemplary deeds demonstrate the high political awareness and noble ideological character of a people's judge, setting a model for the entire national court staff to learn from. Accordingly, the Supreme People's Court has decided to confer on Comrade Chen Jiaqi the title of National Model Judge and calls upon all staff members of the national court system to learn from Comrade Chen Jiaqi.

People's courts at all levels shall incorporate the activities of learning from and publicizing Comrade Chen Jiaqi's deeds into their agenda as part of strengthening the construction of a spiritual civilization within the court system, and shall grasp and implement this work effectively. Through these activities of learning from and publicizing Comrade Chen Jiaqi's deeds, the enthusiasm and creativity of the national court staff shall be stimulated, the revolutionary dedication and political sense of responsibility of the vast number of judicial officers shall be enhanced, and the tasks entrusted to the judicial organs by the Constitution and laws shall be better fulfilled, so as to make greater contributions to the development of socialist democracy, the strengthening of the socialist legal system, and the protection and promotion of the smooth progress of reform, opening-up, and economic construction.

April 26, 1988
